name: Comment on intents and proofs
description: During review, comment(target, text) starts a thread on one intent, one proof or the prose, recorded with the reviewer's name, and reply adds to it. A thread is resolved by its commenter or by the submitter. Threads live in the proposal file, so they work the same from the library, the CLIs (lastro review <proposal> --as <name> comment <id> "..." and resolve), an agent or a UI. Open threads are listed by pending() and, like unresolved intents and unanswered decisions, block approval.

proofs.name: Who resolves a thread
proofs.description: A thread is resolved by the person who started it or by the submitter, and by no one else.
proofs.subject: thread_resolve

proofs.name: An open thread blocks approval
proofs.description: While a thread is open the proposal is not ready to approve.
proofs.subject: approval_policy
